security_audit.summary: The obfuscation alerts are false positives caused by readable Japanese Markdown and shell prompt text, not encoded payloads. External command use is real because the skill instructs users to run a shell script that invokes Gemini CLI, and the script uses `--yolo` with a user-controlled prompt.

remediation.issue: Gemini CLI is invoked with --yolo and a user-controlled query.
remediation.suggestion: Remove --yolo, require interactive approval, and add prompt-injection guidance for untrusted queries and web content.

remediation.issue: The skill relies on a local shell script and external Gemini CLI command.
remediation.suggestion: Document the dependency, constrain arguments, validate query length, and describe expected network behavior before installation.

semantic_findings.title: Autonomous Gemini CLI Execution
semantic_findings.description: The script invokes Gemini CLI with `--yolo` while embedding the user query directly in the prompt. A malicious query or web result could cause unintended agent actions if Gemini CLI has tools or file access.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The command line clearly includes a user-controlled prompt and the --yolo flag. The exact Gemini CLI permissions depend on the runtime, so confidence is high but not absolute.

content.user_title: Search the Web with Gemini CLI
content.value_statement: Current research tasks need fresh sources and concise summaries. This skill runs Gemini CLI search and asks it to return sourced Markdown.
actual_capabilities: Runs scripts/web-search.sh with a natural language search query.
Sends the query to Gemini CLI with the gemini prompt option.
Requests Markdown answers that include all referenced URLs.
Supports research for releases, documentation, errors, news, best practices, and comparisons.
Provides example search workflows for common developer research tasks.
limitations: Requires Gemini CLI to be installed and authenticated in the local environment.
Runs a shell script and external CLI, so some installers may require review.
Search quality depends on Gemini web access and available source material.
Does not independently verify each source for accuracy or authority.

use_cases.title: Research Framework Updates
use_cases.description: Find current release notes and summarize important changes before planning upgrades.

use_cases.title: Investigate Technical Errors
use_cases.description: Search documentation, issues, and community answers to understand likely fixes for an error.

use_cases.title: Prepare Source-Based Briefs
use_cases.description: Collect current references and turn them into a concise brief with source links.

prompt_templates.title: Find Official Sources
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for current official information about [topic]. Summarize the key points and include the source URLs.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate an Error
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for causes and fixes for [error message]. Prioritize official docs, issue trackers, and recent reliable sources.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Technical Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [option A] and [option B] for [use case]. Cover strengths, limits, adoption signals, and source links.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Research Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [topic] across official releases, documentation, and expert analysis. Produce a structured brief with risks, recommendations, and sources.

output_examples.output: A concise Markdown summary with release context, major changes, migration notes, and source URLs.

output_examples.input: Find causes for a TypeScript assignment type error.
output_examples.output: A troubleshooting answer that explains common causes, practical fixes, and links to relevant documentation or issue discussions.

output_examples.input: Compare Vite and Webpack for a new frontend project.
output_examples.output: A source-backed comparison covering build speed, ecosystem fit, configuration needs, and recommended use cases.

best_practices: Ask for official docs or primary sources when accuracy matters.
Use specific dates, versions, and product names in the query.
Review source URLs before using results for decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not pass secrets, private customer data, or credentials in search queries.
Do not treat generated summaries as verified facts without checking sources.
Do not use the skill for tasks that should stay inside the workspace.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It runs Gemini CLI to perform web research and return a sourced Markdown answer.

faq.question: Does it require Gemini CLI?
faq.answer: Yes. The local environment must have Gemini CLI installed and configured.

faq.question: Can it use current web information?
faq.answer: It is designed for current web research when Gemini CLI has web access.

faq.question: Does it cite sources?
faq.answer: The script asks Gemini to include all referenced URLs in the answer.

faq.question: Is it safe for private data?
faq.answer: No. Do not place secrets, credentials, or sensitive private data in search queries.

faq.question: Does it use external commands?
faq.answer: Yes. It runs a shell script that calls Gemini CLI, so review permissions before installation.
